steps.name: Validate fee change request
steps.guidance: The request must contain a complete fee schedule.

steps.name: Send updated 408(b)(2) disclosure
steps.guidance: Changes to disclosed compensation must be disclosed as soon as practicable, and no later than 60 days after the provider learns of the change.

steps.name: Apply new fee schedule on recordkeeper
steps.guidance: Submits the new fee schedule to the recordkeeper.
